headline: Ravens OLB Trey Hendrickson Undergoes Finger Surgery, Will Miss Week 4
summary: The Ravens will go without star pass rusher Trey Hendrickson against the Titans on Sunday. Head coach Jesse Minter announced Hendrickson underwent finger surgery, adding that the outside linebacker’s absence should be “very, very short term” (via Jamison Hensley of ESPN).
